prompt: Improve this card list for a library app. HTML: three cards, each with a book title, an author line, a 2-line synopsis, and two buttons 'Reserve' and 'Details'. Currently every element has 16px margin all around, so the title and author have the same gap to each other as the synopsis and buttons, and all cards touch with 0 gap. Return an HTML file with inline CSS, system fonts, no external assets.
pick_rule: Chosen as the task with the largest judged difference in favor of the skill among tasks where the skill loaded and the answers can be shown without altering them.
